00046 class DelayBaseUGenInternal : public UGenInternal
00047 {
00048 public:
00049     DelayBaseUGenInternal(const int numInputs, UGen const& input, UGen const& delayTime, Buffer const& delayBuffer) throw();
00050     UGenInternal* getChannel(const int channel) throw() = 0;        // final subclasses now MUST implment this..                        
00051     
00052     enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, NumInputs };
00053     
00054 protected:
00055 
00056     // perhaps move these lookups to Buffer?
00057     inline float lookupIndexN(const int index)
00058     {
00059         return bufferSamples[index];
00060     }
00061     
00062     // must make this more efficient
00063     inline float lookupIndexL(const float fIndex)
00064     {
00065         const int iIndex0 = (int)fIndex;
00066         const int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00067         const float frac = fIndex - (float)iIndex0;
00068         const float value0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00069         float value1;
00070         
00071         if(iIndex1 == delayBuffer_.size()) {
00072             value1 = bufferSamples[0];
00073         } else {    
00074             value1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00075         }
00076         
00077         return value0 + frac * (value1 - value0);
00078     }
00079     
00080     // 0 is one ahead, 1 is this, 2 is on behind, 3 is two behind
00081     //static float cubicinterp(float x, float y0, float y1, float y2, float y3)
00082     inline float lookupIndexC(const float fIndex)
00083     {
00084         const int iIndex1 = (int)fIndex;
00085         const int iIndex0 = iIndex1+1;
00086         const int iIndex2 = iIndex1-1;
00087         const int iIndex3 = iIndex1-2;
00088         const float y0 = bufferSamples[iIndex0];
00089         const float y1 = bufferSamples[iIndex1];
00090         const float y2 = bufferSamples[iIndex2];
00091         const float y3 = bufferSamples[iIndex3];
00092         
00093         const float frac = fIndex - iIndex1;
00094         
00095         // 4-point, 3rd-order Hermite (x-form)
00096         float c0 = y1;
00097         float c1 = 0.5f * (y2 - y0);
00098         float c2 = y0 - 2.5f * y1 + 2.f * y2 - 0.5f * y3;
00099         float c3 = 0.5f * (y3 - y0) + 1.5f * (y1 - y2);
00100         
00101         return ((c3 * frac + c2) * frac + c1) * frac + c0;
00102     }
00103     
00104     Buffer delayBuffer_;
00105     const double delayBufferSize;
00106     float *bufferSamples;
00107     int bufferWritePos;
00108 };

00129 class RecircBaseUGenInternal : public DelayBaseUGenInternal
00130 {
00131 public: 
00132     RecircBaseUGenInternal(UGen const& input, UGen const& delayTime, UGen const& decayTime, Buffer const& delayBuffer) throw();
00133     
00134     enum Inputs { Input, DelayTime, DecayTime, NumInputs };
00135     
00136 protected:
00137 
00138     inline float calcFeedback(float delay, float decay)
00139     {
00140         if (delay == 0.f) {
00141             return 0.f;
00142         } else if (decay > 0.f) {
00143             return (float)std::exp(log001 * delay / decay);
00144         } else if (decay < 0.f) {
00145             return (float)-std::exp(log001 * delay / -decay);
00146         } else {
00147             return 0.f;
00148         }
00149     }
00150     
00151 
00152     float currentDelay;
00153     float currentDecay;
00154     float feedback;
00155 };

00249 template<class RecircBaseType>
00250 class RecircBaseChain : public UGen
00251 {
00252 public:
00253     
00256     class RecircBaseChainLink : public ChainBankEvent < >
00257     {
00258     public:
00267         RecircBaseChainLink(const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00268                             ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00269                             ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00270         :   maximumDelayTime_(maximumDelayTime),
00271             delayTime_(delayTime),
00272             decayTime_(decayTime)
00273         {
00274         }
00275         
00280         UGen createEvent(UGen const& input, const int eventCount)
00281         {
00282             return RecircBaseType::AR(input, maximumDelayTime_, delayTime_, decayTime_);
00283         }
00284         
00285     private:
00286         float maximumDelayTime_;
00287         ValueArray const& delayTime_;
00288         ValueArray const& decayTime_;
00289     };
00290     
00301     static UGen AR(UGen const& input, 
00302                    const int size,
00303                    const float maximumDelayTime = 0.2f, 
00304                    ValueArray const& delayTime = 0.2f, 
00305                    ValueArray const& decayTime = 0.2f)
00306     {
00307         int numChannels = input.getNumChannels();
00308         if(delayTime.size() > numChannels)
00309             numChannels = delayTime.size();
00310         if(decayTime.size() > numChannels)
00311             numChannels = decayTime.size();
00312             
00313         return Chain<RecircBaseChainLink>::AR(RecircBaseChainLink(maximumDelayTime, 
00314                                                                   delayTime, 
00315                                                                   decayTime),
00316                                               input, size, numChannels);
00317     }
00318     
00319 private:
00320     RecircBaseChain();
00321 };
